claims.text: OpenAI published Reimagining advertising with AI at 13:00 UTC on 16 September 2026.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 RSS pubDate and s1 page title/date

claims.text: OpenAI says clicking an ad can open a clearly labelled conversation with a business-sponsored agent that is distinct from ChatGPT's independent answer and separate from the original conversation.
claims.sourceLocator: Being part of the AI conversation

claims.text: Sponsored Agents are in a limited alpha for selected US advertisers, and OpenAI is not accepting early-access requests.
claims.sourceLocator: s1 US test; s3 availability and early access

claims.text: A click-through metric cannot establish whether a subsequent multi-turn agent preserves disclosure, answers accurately, handles data appropriately or stops correctly.
claims.sourceLocator: Inference from the documented multi-turn format, advertiser responsibility and disclosure requirements

claims.text: OpenAI's Ad Tools Terms deem the advertiser the builder and responsible for Sponsored Agent content, configurations, Actions and output.
OpenAI's Advertising Terms allocate responsibility for campaign settings, instructions, destinations and AI-generated outputs and require disclosures and claim substantiation.
OpenAI's Service terms require information published about a GPT to remain complete, accurate and not misleading.
OpenAI's ad policies prohibit misleading capability, pricing, outcome, affiliation and comparison claims and ads that imitate the ChatGPT interface.
OpenAI says advertisers cannot access a person's chats, chat history, memories or personal details, and users can manage ad personalisation.
The inspected public launch and help pages do not specify advertiser access to sponsored-conversation content, retention, reporting, human hand-off or the alpha's action set.
claims.sourceLocator: Scope comparison across inspected product/help pages and conditional Actions terms

claims.text: Operators should map data at each transition and confirm undocumented boundaries rather than infer either access or isolation.
claims.sourceLocator: Recommendation from documented separation, responsibilities and public documentation gaps

claims.text: The Beginning of ChatGPT Ads preprint used 91 controlled accounts and collected more than 3,000 ads from 186 advertisers across 335 prompts.
The preprint authors report that the earlier ads were clearly separated from ChatGPT responses and mostly directed users towards advertisers rather than specific products.
The preprint's February-to-August 2026 chronology means it did not evaluate Sponsored Agents announced in September.
claims.sourceLocator: s10 abstract and submission history compared with s2 exact launch time

claims.text: FTC native-advertising guidance says the overall impression and commercial source matter and that disclosure may need to appear again on a click-into page near the advertising message.
A useful Sponsored Agents pilot should test disclosure persistence, claim grounding, data boundaries, Actions and hand-off, completion states and auditability across the whole interaction.
claims.sourceLocator: Original operator framework derived from documented format, responsibilities, general disclosure guidance and earlier audit method
